verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a rule or trigger facility that automatically starts actions in response to events. Schedules are time-based recurring triggers, not event rules. Signals and Workflows-as-Code are developer building blocks for constructing such logic. Automatic Activity retries are a narrow failure-recovery behavior, not user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
